author: William F. West
title: Suspect linked to shooting at football game is in custody, sheriff's office says - NewsBreak
text:
By William F. West ,
5 hours ago
A suspect is in custody in connection with the shooting that occurred during the recent high school football game between the Tarboro Vikings and the SouthWest Edgecombe Cougars, the Edgecombe County Sheriff’s Office said Wednesday.
Detectives on Tuesday met with the Raleigh Police Department and took the suspect, a 17-year-old, into custody at a house in Raleigh, the sheriff’s office said in a social media post.
The shooting incident on Friday resulted in two teens being injured.
In the sheriff’s office’s social media post, authorities said that the investigation is continuing and that detectives are continuing to ask anyone with video footage of the shooting to contact them and provide them with that footage to help assist with the probe.
Edgecombe County Sheriff Clee Atkinson, in a news conference Monday afternoon at the sheriff’s office, said that a 17-year-old suspect was wanted in connection with the shooting, which occurred at 8:33 p.m. Friday near the concession stand at SouthWest Edgecombe High School’s football stadium.
Atkinson said that the shooting occurred within 10 feet of two deputies who were standing in the crowd and near the concession stand.
A 17-year-old who said he had been hit received medical attention from emergency medical services personnel, who took him to ECU Health Medical Center in Greenville, Atkinson said.
The teen was shot once in the back but remains in stable condition, Atkinson said.
Deputies recovered a spent 9 mm casing in the area of the concession stand.
At 9:49 p.m., the sheriff’s office received a call from UNC Health Nash about a 16-year-old girl who entered the hospital seeking treatment from a graze wound to one of her hands.
During Monday’s news conference, Atkinson said that before the shooting there had been an altercation, with one person drawing a handgun and firing.
The altercation was not linked to the football rivalry between Tarboro High and SouthWest Edgecombe High, Atkinson said.
The sheriff’s office posted at 12:01 p.m. Wednesday about the suspect being in custody.
SouthWest Edgecombe High is off N.C. 43 and northwest of Pinetops.
